name: Slide Show
description: A playlist track that shows a data source's pages one at a time, each for its minutes. A source with a list (a feed, a folder) goes on where the last visit stopped and is fetched again when it is used up.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Lists After
properties.description: A kept list that its slot has not used for this many days is removed (a track you deleted). 0: never.

properties.name: slideMax
properties.title: Max Slides
properties.description: Maximum number of images in the slideshow. Zero for 'unlimited'. Shown only for a data source with several pages (a source of one picture shows one).

properties.name: listMode
properties.title: Slides in a List
properties.description: Shown only for a data source with a real list (a feed, a folder). continue: each visit goes on where the last one stopped, and the list is fetched again when it is used up. restart: every visit starts at the top of a new list.

properties.name: refreshHours
properties.title: Fetch Again After
properties.description: With continue: the list is shown item by item until it is used up, then fetched again and started over, so new items turn up in time. 0: only then. More than 0: also when the list is older than this, even when some is left.

properties.name: showAs
properties.title: Show As
properties.description: auto: as the data source says (a text page overrides, a picture is a background). background: the overlays are drawn on it. blend: washes over the page before it, without the overlays. override: covers everything (only a priority image is drawn over it).
